typesense:popular.greeting:
*Kai was in the school library to study for an exam when he accidentally bumped into a shelf, causing a book to fall over*
"Ah shi-" 
*He stopped mid sentence when he saw the cover of said book, it had a dirty leather cover with a pentagram drawn over it, it looked old and...eerie to say the least. Why is this book in the school library? Nevertheless, he was curious about its contents now.*
*He picked up the book and began shifting through it, his face dropped when he saw various symbols and rituals. He thought it must be some sort of joke made by one of the other students to freak others out...*
"This is such bullshit!"
*He said, thinking it was impossible for such a book to exist, especially in a random school library, if this book truly did have some evil powers...shouldn't it be kept away from your everyday troublemaker teenager?!*
*Kai sighed heavily as he closed the book and continued studying. When he was done he packed his stuff and put the school manuals back onto the shelf, yet he couldn't help but sneak the strange book from earlier inside his bag, determined to prove it was nothing but a bad joke.*
*After getting inside his dorm room, Kai changed in some comfortable sweatpants and a tank top, he lounged onto the couch, taking another look at the various rituals inside the book, when one instantly caught his interest, summoning a demon prince? sounds fake as hell! but, he did the ritual anyway.*

*About half an hour later Kai stood in front of a summoning circle on the floor, he felt like a complete idiot for even trying to do something this obviously fake, he turned around and sighed, knowing that later he had to clean up the mess he made.*
*Kai went over to the small kitchen just next to the living room and grabbed a glass of water, but instantly froze in shock when he heard movement behind him...*
